description: The perception module’s decision, pinned for fixed inputs (US-3 of 121-stealth-and-perception). Each case carries the WHOLE DetectionInput — the observer roster with its per-channel acuities, the targets with the host’s measurements of them (location, light, stance, noise, concealment), the host’s SensorReadings, the memory carried in from the previous tick, the fully resolved DetectionTuning, the seed and the tick — so a harness in any language reproduces it with no defaults table, no world file and no KB. The one thing core cannot know arrives as an input exactly as it does at runtime: a SensorReading is what the host’s IPerceptionProbe answered, and core performs no geometry, holds no position and reads no clock. `expected.updates` is one DetectionUpdate per (observer, target) pair, sorted by (observer CURIE, target CURIE); `expected.memory` is what the next tick carries in; `expected.facts` is the { retract, assert } delta in the 110 predicate vocabulary (awareness/3 + detection_state/3, and NOTHING for a tick that moved neither); and `expected.perceptions` / `beliefFacts` / `perceptFacts` / `perceivedFacts` are the substrate’s own perception pass (src/ai/perception.ts) verbatim, because detection runs no second sensing model. `unaware` is never asserted — it is the absence of a detection_state/3 fact. Awareness is integer; confidences round to four decimals; every draw comes from a stream derived from (seed, tick, agent CURIE, percept id) rather than from call order, so reversing the roster must not move one byte. Regenerate with `npm run stealth-corpus`.

cases.name: unaware-one-tick-of-perfect-sight-is-not-detection
cases.note: THE case the module exists for. The host reported a clear, unobstructed, fully lit view — and the guard is still `unaware`, because detection accumulates. An implementation that answers `detects/2` and stops has a guard who is omniscient the instant a ray connects, and it passes nothing else in this file.

cases.name: suspicious-the-band-the-world-authored-and-not-a-constant
cases.note: The first rung, reached by carrying the previous tick's level in. 24 + one clear sighting crosses the authored `suspicious` band at 25 — a number that lives in `WorldIR.perception` and reaches the KB as `detection_threshold/2`, so a jumpy world and a half-asleep one differ by content. The delta retracts the old level rather than accumulating a second `awareness/3`.

cases.name: searching-the-second-rung-and-the-belief-that-comes-with-it
cases.note: The middle rung. Worth its own case because `searching_for/2` is the state a guard ACTS on and the belief pinned beside it is what they act on it WITH — the location they perceived, stamped this tick, not the location the target is at.

cases.name: alerted-the-top-rung-is-reached-in-one-step-not-climbed-through
cases.note: Rising is immediate: a guard who sees you does not wait to be sure. This pair’s recorded rung is `unaware` and sight and hearing together carry it over the top band in one tick, so it lands on `alerted` without passing through the two rungs between — and the two channels are SUMMED, because two senses agreeing is stronger evidence than either alone. A port that steps one rung per tick, or that takes the best channel instead of the sum, reproduces the three cases above and fails this one.

cases.name: hysteresis-holds-the-rung-when-the-level-dips-below-the-band
cases.note: Falling is NOT immediate, and this is the half every implementation gets wrong. The guard perceived nothing this tick, so the level decays below the `alerted` band — and the rung holds, because it is only left once the level is the authored `hysteresis` margin below the band that reached it. Without this an observer sitting on a threshold oscillates every tick, which is binary seen/unseen in a slower costume.

cases.name: hysteresis-releases-once-the-level-falls-the-authored-margin
cases.note: The other side of the same number, one tick further down: 72 decays to 66, which is below `alerted` (80) minus `hysteresis` (10), so the rung finally drops — and it drops to the rung the level actually sits on (`searching`, 50), not one step down a ladder. A port that pins only the case above cannot tell a working hysteresis from a rung that never falls at all.

cases.name: negative-a-pair-the-host-reported-nothing-for-is-not-on-the-ladder
cases.note: THE negative case, and the one that stops the corpus passing vacuously. The roster has an observer and a target, the target is lit and upright, and the host supplied NO reading — so there is no update, no memory and an empty fact delta. A pair with no reading was not sensed at all, which is a different thing from sensed badly. An implementation that seeds every pair "at awareness 0" produces one update here and passes every other case in this file.

cases.name: negative-darkness-below-the-authored-floor-is-not-seen
cases.note: A second negative, and a different mechanism: the host reported a perfect line of sight, and the light it also reported is below the authored `lightFloor`, so the sighting presents at strength zero and nothing is perceived. The host measured; the world decided what the measurement is WORTH. A silent target in the dark is genuinely invisible, and that is the promise the whole mechanic rests on.

cases.name: negative-a-sense-the-creature-lacks-perceives-nothing-however-clear
cases.note: A third negative, on the substrate's own rule: the hound has no sight at all, the host reported visibility 1, and the target makes no noise. A missing channel is a sense the creature does not have — not a sense with acuity zero — so there is nothing to fold and the pair never reaches the ladder.

cases.name: the-belief-is-not-refreshed-on-a-tick-nobody-perceived
cases.note: THE stealth case, and the one a port cannot get right by accident. The guard believes the thief is in the vault; the thief is in the CELLAR; the host reported no reading. The pinned `believedLocation` is still the vault, `beliefRefreshed` is false, and `believedAt` is the tick it was formed on and not this one. An implementation that reads the target's true location on the observer's behalf pins `cellar` here and has no stealth mechanic at all.

cases.name: a-partial-sighting-teaches-the-coarser-place-the-author-supplied
cases.note: Cover and concealment drop the sighting to `partial` fidelity, and a partial perception learns the author's coarse form — "somewhere in the north wing" — rather than the exact room. That is a genuinely different belief and not the same one with a smaller number on it, which is why the pinned `believedLocation` is the coarse id while the target's `location` is the vault. Cover and concealment MULTIPLY: a port that subtracts them agrees on neither the confidence nor the fidelity band.

cases.name: sound-alone-detects-a-target-that-cannot-be-seen
cases.note: Light does not enter hearing, and stance does: a target in total darkness making a racket is perceived on `hearing` alone, at the authored `senseWeights.hearing` rather than at sight's full value. The pinned `channels` array is how a port proves it summed the right senses — two senses agreeing is stronger evidence than either alone, and here there is only one.

cases.name: distraction-damps-the-gain-of-the-observer-it-was-spent-on
cases.note: Two observers, the same target, the same reading, the same tick — and the distracted one gained less. Distraction is the OBSERVER's parameter (mid-fight, in conversation, drunk) where light and cover are the target's, and what full distraction costs is the authored `distractionWeight`. Both updates are in one case precisely so a port cannot pass by applying the damping to everybody.

cases.name: an-act-is-perceived-in-the-same-pass-and-moves-nothing-on-the-ladder
cases.note: A stealth act rides its ACTOR's reading — an observer who could not sense the thief could not have seen what the thief did — and it is published as a percept in the one pass everything else is perceived in, its id being the enforcement event id. What it does NOT do is move awareness: the pinned update is identical to the tick without it, because two ways for one act to raise suspicion would be two mechanics. What an act costs is the authored `awarenessDelta` of its row, applied once, by the decision layer.

cases.name: negative-an-act-nobody-could-sense-is-still-an-act-and-is-witnessed-by-nobody
cases.note: The negative case for witnessing, and the one that pins the correction US-3 brought back to the substrate (`docs/game-ai-substrate.md` §9). The identical act, on a tick the host reported no reading for: nothing is perceived, so no `perceived/4` and no `percept/4` — and the pass STILL publishes `percept_actor/2` and `percept_channel/2`, because an act's existence is not its content and `unwitnessed/1` is written over exactly that fact. A port that withholds all three answers "witnessed" to every crime nobody saw.

cases.name: the-jitter-draw-is-derived-from-identity-and-not-from-call-order
cases.note: The one case with the authored jitter left ON, and two observers whose readings are identical — so the only thing that can separate their confidences is the per-agent stream, derived from (seed, tick, agent CURIE, percept id). A port that advances one RNG per perception reproduces every jitter-off case in this file and disagrees here, and it would also disagree with itself when the roster is reversed.
